notes: A BROUGHT-FORWARD CHEQUE FROM A CLOSED YEAR CAN NOW BE PUT TO REST WITHOUT REWRITING HISTORY. When a cheque issued in a previous year goes stale and you have already written it back with your own journal entry, the Cheque & Lodgement Register now lets you close the cheque AGAINST THAT JOURNAL — open the cheque's actions and choose CLOSE VIA JOURNAL, then enter the journal's code. The register checks the journal is posted, hits the right bank account, and matches the cheque to the pesewa before accepting it. Reconciliations you have already signed off keep the cheque under unpresented cheques exactly as they showed it on the day; only reconciliations after the journal's date stop carrying it. IF YOU PRESSED REINSTATE ON SUCH A CHEQUE and it posted a second write-back on top of your own journal, reverse that duplicate journal first (Journals, Reverse, stating the reason), then use Close via journal against your original entry — the ledger ends up holding the write-back exactly once, on the date you posted it. Reinstate remains the right tool when no write-back exists yet. There is NO database change: your data and settings are untouched, and the upgrade is simply installing over the old version.
